title: Book Exhibit in Maine
content: An exhibition of children’s book illustration has opened at the University of New England’s gallery in Portland, Maine, curated by its director, Anne Zill, at left.The show includes original works by Dr. Seuss, Maurice Sendak, Jules Feiffer, Jerry Pinkney, Eric Carle, Barry Moser, and Trina Schart Hyman.I’m honored to have two Dinotopia paintings in the show, “Windmill Village” and “Gold Dome.” The exhibition is on view through Oct. 30 ."Children's Book Illustrators" official show site.http://www.une.edu/artgallery/childrensbook.cfmThanks to A.Y. Kamila of the Portland Press Herald blog for the photo.
